name: Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant // Phoenix, Warden of Fire
oracle_text:
When Joshua enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
{3}{R}{W}, {T}: Exile Joshua, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: When Joshua enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.
{3}{R}{W}, {T}: Exile Joshua, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: an op that exiles a permanent and immediately returns it to the battlefield **transformed, under its owner's control** -- as a new object, so it enters, its enters triggers fire, it is summoning sick, and counters/auras/control effects on the old object are gone. The Final Fantasy "Dominant" transforming cycle prints this line on both faces
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `transform` (ops_board.py `op_transform`) turns the permanent over **in place**: it calls `primitives.transform` on the live object, so the permanent never changes zones, keeps its counters, attachments and summoning-sickness state, and fires no leaves-the-battlefield or enters triggers. That is a materially stronger and differently-timed card. `exile` can move it out but has no return path other than `until_leaves` (the O-Ring link, which hands back on a later trigger, untransformed), and neither `put_onto_battlefield` nor `return_from_graveyard` accepts any "arrives on its back face" flag -- the only back-face-on-arrival path in the engine is `graveyard_cast_transformed`, which is disturb/`stack.py` and applies to *casting* the card from the graveyard, not to an activated ability on the battlefield. `meld` is the one op that does the exile-and-re-enter dance, but it is hard-wired to `melds_with`/`melds_into` and needs a partner permanent

needs.what: The card index must store a transforming card's BACK FACE text. `data/catalog/cards.sqlite` has one `oracle_text` column per card and for layout 'transform' it holds only the front face, so the back face's printed lines exist nowhere in the repo. Joshua's back is a Saga with chapters that cannot be invented. Fixing it is `scripts/build_card_index.py` reading `card_faces[1]` (text, type line, mana cost, power/toughness), a re-pull of the Scryfall bulk dump -- none is cached under data/catalog/bulk -- and a `authoring/packet.py` change to pass it through.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Not a DSL gap at all: `back_face` in schema.py already supports a second card entry and henrika_domnathi ships one. The data is missing rather than the vocabulary. It affects 488 transform/modal_dfc cards in the catalog, so it is its own build item rather than something to solve inside one card's authoring run.
